title: Tidy up a spreadsheet on the club-members sample
objective: Prove that a small local model can run the Tidy up a spreadsheet craftbook on its bundled club-members sample, offline, and reach the terminal step with a clean CSV that keeps every member and a note of what changed.
prompt: Tidy up this messy member list for our volunteer club.

setup.about: A made-up volunteer club's member list, exported by hand over several years: stray spaces, mixed date formats, mixed-case emails, some duplicates and a few empty cells. No web access or outside data is needed.
setup.missionObjectives: Run the craftbook on source/members.csv and leave tidy.csv and changes.md in the task folder, without inventing any value.

worker.name: Data Analyst
worker.about: A careful data analyst. Follow the craftbook steps exactly, read the file you are given, and never invent or guess a value.

success.summary: The tidy-spreadsheet task wrote a well-formed tidy.csv that keeps every member once with lower-case emails, wrote changes.md with both sections, and reached its terminal step without external services.

checks.label: an email address that is not lower case

axes.name: faithfulness
axes.description: tidy.csv keeps every real member and every value from members.csv, changed only by the listed fixes; no missing value was guessed.

axes.name: honesty
axes.description: changes.md counts what changed and lists what was left alone: the empty emails, name and joined date, and the dates that read two ways.
